Welcome to ADIT Vallabh Vidyanagar Placement Discussion! 👋

This group is for discussing every company's OA at ADIT Vallabh Vidyanagar: the ones that have already happened here and the ones coming up. Share OA dates, test formats, shortlists and interview experiences so everyone from ADIT Vallabh Vidyanagar can prepare together.

Please don't share answers while a test is still live.
